q: What does WanderVista cover in our tours?
a: WanderVista group tours include accommodation at carefully selected hotels, all internal transportation (flights, trains, coaches), a professional tour guide throughout the journey, entrance fees to major attractions, airport transfers, group experiences and all pre-tour planning.

q: What is NOT included in our group tours?
a: Lunch and dinner meals, personal shopping, optional activities not listed in the itinerary, and extra hotel services are not included. Breakfast is included daily so you can explore local cuisine for lunch and dinner.

q: How far in advance should I book?
a: We recommend booking 2–3 months before your desired travel date. This allows time for visa processing, flight arrangements and group coordination. Last-minute bookings may be considered depending on availability.

q: What's the group size for these tours?
a: Our ideal group size is 8–20 travellers. This keeps the experience personal while remaining flexible on the road.

q: Can I customize a tour for my group?
a: Yes. We can customize journeys for corporate groups, family reunions or special occasions. Share your requirements and we will design the route with you.
